# Packages

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

```

# Get items

## Query data

```{r}
#| label: fetch-items
#| code-summary: "Fetch National Council items and cache them"
#| cache: true
#| eval: false

  map(., \(x) get_items(legis_period = x, institution = "NR")) %>%
  list_rbind()
nrow(items_20_28)
```

## Keep items of interest

```{r}
#| label: define-item-scope
#| code-summary: "Select legislative item types"
items_select <- c("^A$", "RV", "BUA", "GABR", "GABR13", "BRA", "^EBR$") %>%
  paste0(., collapse = "|")

items_scope <- items_20_28 %>%
  filter(str_detect(type_doc, regex(items_select)))

items_scope %>%
  distinct(type_doc_long, type_doc)
```

# Get item details

## Query data

```{r}
#| label: fetch-item-details
#| code-summary: "Fetch item details with stages and cache them"
#| cache: true
#| eval: false
plan(multisession, workers = 4)

item_urls <- items_scope %>%
  pull(item_url)

safe_get_item_details <- safely(get_item_details)

item_details_raw <- item_urls %>%
  future_map(
    \(x) {
      safe_result <- safe_get_item_details(item_url = x, stages = TRUE)
      safe_result$item_url <- x
      safe_result
    },
    .progress = TRUE,
    .options = furrr_options(packages = c("ParlAT", "purrr", "tibble"))
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: load-item-details-cache
#| eval: true
#| include: false
# readr::write_rds(

#     "_data",

#   )
# )

# plan(sequential)

item_details_raw <- readr::read_rds(here::here(
  "posts",
  "2026-06-08-ParlAT-votingPatterns-2",
  "_data",
  "item_details_raw.rds"
))
```

## Prepare stages data

```{r}
#| label: prepare-stages-data
#| code-summary: "Unnest stages, filter vote rows, add reading and vote_text_list columns"
failed_items <- item_details_raw |>
  keep(\(x) !is.null(x$error)) |>
  map(\(x) tibble(item_url = x$item_url, error = conditionMessage(x$error))) |>
  list_rbind()

item_details <- item_details_raw |>
  keep(\(x) is.null(x$error)) |>
  map("result") |>
  list_rbind()

# unnest stages into one row per stage per item
item_stages <- item_details |>
  select(item_url, legis_period, type_doc, title, item_number,
         status_number, status_description, stages) |>
  filter(map_lgl(stages, \(x) !is.null(x))) |>
  unnest(stages)

# keep only rows that contain vote results, then parse them
item_stages_votes <- item_stages |>
  filter(str_detect(stage_name, "\nDafür:")) |>
  mutate(
    stage_description = str_extract(stage_name, "^[^\n]+"),
    vote_text         = str_extract(stage_name, "(?<=\n)Dafür:.+"),

    reading = case_when(
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("dritter? Lesung",   ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "dritte",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("zweiter? Lesung",   ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "zweite",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("erste[rn]? Lesung", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "erste",
      str_detect(phase,             regex("Ausschuss",         ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Ausschuss",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Entschlie.*?ungsantrag", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Entschließungsantrag",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Ab.*?nderungsantrag",    ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Abänderungsantrag",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Antrag auf besondere Kundmachung", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Antrag auf bes. Kundmachung",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Wiederholung",      ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Wiederholung",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Genehmigung",       ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Genehmigung",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Erm.*?chtigung",    ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Ermächtigung",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Abstimmung",        ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Abstimmung",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Beschluss",         ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Beschluss",
      str_detect(stage_description, regex("Antrag",            ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Antrag",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    vote_text_list = map(vote_text, function(vt) {
      vt_norm <- str_replace(vt, fixed(". Dagegen:"), ", dagegen:")
      parts   <- str_split(vt_norm, ", dagegen:", n = 2)[[1]]
      dafuer  <- parts[1] |> str_remove("^Dafür: ") |> str_split(", ") |> unlist() |> str_trim()
      gegen   <- if (length(parts) == 2) parts[2] |> str_split(", ") |> unlist() |> str_trim() else character(0)
      list(dafuer = dafuer, gegen = gegen)
    })
  ) |>
  select(-stage_name, -speeches)
```

# Vote flips across readings

## Build flip dataset

```{r}
#| label: build-flips
#| code-summary: "Identify parties that flipped position between zweite and dritte Lesung"
# For bundled items with multiple votes per reading, keep the first only
readings_23 <- item_stages_votes |>
  filter(reading %in% c("zweite", "dritte")) |>
  slice_head(n = 1, by = c(item_url, reading)) |>
  filter(n_distinct(reading) == 2, .by = item_url)

# self-join to get zweite and dritte side by side per item
zweite <- readings_23 |>
  filter(reading == "zweite") |>
  select(item_url, legis_period, type_doc, title, item_number,
         vote_text_zweite = vote_text_list)

dritte <- readings_23 |>
  filter(reading == "dritte") |>
  select(item_url, vote_text_dritte = vote_text_list)

flips <- inner_join(zweite, dritte, by = "item_url") |>
  mutate(
    dafuer_zweite = map(vote_text_zweite, "dafuer"),
    gegen_zweite  = map(vote_text_zweite, "gegen"),
    dafuer_dritte = map(vote_text_dritte, "dafuer"),
    gegen_dritte  = map(vote_text_dritte, "gegen"),

    # gegen in zweite -> dafuer in dritte
    flip_pos = map2(gegen_zweite, dafuer_dritte, intersect),
    # dafuer in zweite -> gegen in dritte
    flip_neg = map2(dafuer_zweite, gegen_dritte, intersect),

    n_flip_pos = map_int(flip_pos, length),
    n_flip_neg = map_int(flip_neg, length)
  ) |>
  select(-vote_text_zweite, -vote_text_dritte)
```

```{r}
#| label: cache-flips
#| include: false
# readr::write_rds(
#   flips,
#   here::here(
#     "posts",
#     "2026-06-08-ParlAT-votingPatterns-2",
#     "_data",
#     "flips.rds"
#   )
# )
flips <- readr::read_rds(here::here(
  "posts",
  "2026-06-08-ParlAT-votingPatterns-2",
  "_data",
  "flips.rds"
))
```

## Visualise flips

```{r}
#| label: plot-vote-flips
#| code-summary: "Tile plot: vote flips by party and legislative period"
#| column: body-outset-right
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: "center"
library(ggpattern)

gov_parties_lookup <- tribble(
  ~legis_period, ~party,
  "XX","SPÖ",   "XX","ÖVP",
  "XXI","ÖVP",  "XXI","F",
  "XXII","ÖVP", "XXII","F",   "XXII","F-BZÖ",
  "XXIII","SPÖ","XXIII","ÖVP",
  "XXIV","SPÖ", "XXIV","ÖVP",
  "XXV","SPÖ",  "XXV","ÖVP",
  "XXVI","ÖVP", "XXVI","FPÖ",
  "XXVII","ÖVP","XXVII","GRÜNE",
  "XXVIII","ÖVP","XXVIII","SPÖ","XXVIII","NEOS"
) |> mutate(is_gov = TRUE)

valid_parties <- c("SPÖ","ÖVP","F","FPÖ","GRÜNE","L","BZÖ","STRONACH",
                   "NEOS","NEOS-LIF","F-BZÖ","JETZT","PILZ","NEOS/NEOS-LIF","JETZT/PILZ")

normalise_party <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p %in% c("NEOS-LIF","NEOS/NEOS-LIF") ~ "NEOS",
    p %in% c("JETZT","PILZ","JETZT/PILZ")  ~ "JETZT/PILZ",
    TRUE ~ p
  )
}

# parties present in parliament per period
parties_per_period <- item_stages_votes |>
  filter(reading == "dritte") |>
  mutate(all_p = map(vote_text_list, \(x) c(x$dafuer, x$gegen))) |>
  unnest(all_p) |>
  mutate(party_clean = str_trim(str_extract(all_p, "^[^(]+"))) |>
  filter(party_clean %in% valid_parties) |>
  mutate(party = normalise_party(party_clean)) |>
  distinct(legis_period, party)

# flip long tables
pos_long <- flips |> filter(n_flip_pos > 0) |> unnest(flip_pos) |>
  rename(party = flip_pos) |> mutate(party = normalise_party(party)) |>
  count(legis_period, party, name = "n") |> mutate(direction = "gegen → dafür")

neg_long <- flips |> filter(n_flip_neg > 0) |> unnest(flip_neg) |>
  rename(party = flip_neg) |> mutate(party = normalise_party(party)) |>
  count(legis_period, party, name = "n") |> mutate(direction = "dafür → gegen")

all_parties <- union(union(pos_long$party, neg_long$party),
                     union("ÖVP", parties_per_period$party))

party_order <- c(
  bind_rows(pos_long, neg_long) |> count(party, wt = n, sort = TRUE) |> pull(party),
  setdiff(all_parties, bind_rows(pos_long, neg_long) |> distinct(party) |> pull(party))
)

all_periods_vec <- c("XX","XXI","XXII","XXIII","XXIV","XXV","XXVI","XXVII","XXVIII")

make_grid <- function(long_df, dir_label) {
  expand_grid(party = all_parties, legis_period = all_periods_vec) |>
    left_join(long_df |> select(party, legis_period, n), by = c("party","legis_period")) |>
    replace_na(list(n = 0)) |>
    left_join(gov_parties_lookup, by = c("party","legis_period")) |>
    replace_na(list(is_gov = FALSE)) |>
    left_join(parties_per_period |> mutate(present = TRUE), by = c("party","legis_period")) |>
    replace_na(list(present = FALSE)) |>
    mutate(
      direction    = dir_label,
      party        = factor(party, levels = rev(party_order)),
      legis_period = factor(legis_period, levels = all_periods_vec),
      label        = if_else(n > 0, as.character(n), ""),
      fill_val     = if_else(present, as.numeric(n), NA_real_)
    )
}

grid_all <- bind_rows(
  make_grid(pos_long, "gegen → dafür"),
  make_grid(neg_long, "dafür → gegen")
) |> mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = c("gegen → dafür","dafür → gegen")))

pal_pos <- "#d73027"
pal_neg <- "#4575b4"
n_max   <- max(grid_all$n, na.rm = TRUE)

flip_base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "Noto Sans") +
  theme(
    panel.grid            = element_blank(),
    axis.text             = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title            = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0,
                                         margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle         = element_text(size = 10, lineheight = 1.3,
                                         colour = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption          = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey45", hjust = 0,
                                         margin = margin(t = 10)),
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    legend.position       = "none"
  )

make_flip_panel <- function(data, dir_label, fill_high, show_y = TRUE) {
  d <- filter(data, direction == dir_label)
  p <- d |>
    ggplot(aes(x = legis_period, y = party, fill = fill_val, pattern = is_gov)) +
    geom_tile_pattern(
      colour          = "white", linewidth = 0.6,
      pattern_colour  = "grey50", pattern_fill = "grey50",
      pattern_density = 0.08,    pattern_spacing = 0.06,
      pattern_alpha   = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_text(data = \(x) filter(x, n > 0),
              aes(x = legis_period, y = party, label = label),
              colour = "white", size = 3.2, fontface = "bold",
              family = "Noto Sans", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey93", high = fill_high,
                        limits = c(0, n_max), na.value = "white", guide = "none") +
    scale_pattern_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "stripe", "FALSE" = "none"), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = dir_label) +
    flip_base_theme +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11,
                                    hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)))
  if (!show_y) p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
  p
}

t_pos <- make_flip_panel(grid_all, "gegen → dafür", pal_pos, show_y = TRUE)
t_neg <- make_flip_panel(grid_all, "dafür → gegen", pal_neg, show_y = FALSE)

(t_pos | t_neg) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Vote flips between zweite and dritte Lesung",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Number of items where a party switched position between second and third reading. ",
      "White = not in parliament. Grey = in parliament, no flips.\n",
      "Diagonal stripe = in government. Left: gegen→dafür. Right: dafür→gegen."
    ),
    caption  = "Data: www.parlament.gv.at via ParlAT. Analysis: Roland Schmidt - @zoowalk.bsky.social",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0,
                                   family = "Noto Sans", margin = margin(b = 4)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30", lineheight = 1.3,
                                   family = "Noto Sans", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption  = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey45", hjust = 0,
                                   family = "Noto Sans", margin = margin(t = 8))
    )
  )
```
